values.value: 5.5 V, 3 A: one USB-C connector for the charger input of F8 and the RP2354B's data lines, with CC1 and CC2
values.refutation_tried: Checked against V13 (same connector, 5 lines, VBUS 5.5 V at 3 A, Research.md:709) and IOBoard.md:398 (Charger input limit, up to 3 A from F8). Consistent. Not named by the 2026-09-30 relaxation, which covers only V9 and V12, so this remains a hard gate P2 cannot relax.

The owner's answer directs research rather than giving a figure. Per the Agent layout rule for P1 ('P2 finds a value marked for research at its primary source and records it as found, not given'), this does not block P2 and is not re-raised here. Not altered by the 2026-09-30 relaxation, which names only V9 and V12.

values.quantity: Highest voltage on USB_DP/USB_DM (steady and ESD clamp)
values.value: Steady: 3.63 V. ESD: clamping voltage at most 36 V at 16 A TLP (IEC 61000-4-2 ±8 kV contact at 30 ns), ahead of the 27 Ω series resistor; relaxed (owner, 2026-09-30) so a standard part's datasheet figure stands where it misses this
values.source: Research.md, Raised by P1, V12 (owner, 2026-09-28; relaxed owner, 2026-09-30)
values.refutation_tried: 3.63 V matches Table 1441's QSPI_IOVDD maximum and the fault-tolerant GPIO maximum IOBoard.md:135 states at IOVDD 0 V, so it is consistent with the RP2350's own 3.3 V-domain ceiling. The dedicated USB_DP/USB_DM pins (QFN-80 pins 67/66) are not in the GPIO table (1427) R1 checked in T1, so this figure's datasheet pedigree for the USB PHY pins specifically is not shown on the page; it stands as the owner's own figure (owner, 2026-09-28), which needs no further sourcing to govern P2.
